description: Source file implementing the MediaPipelineCapabilitiesModuleService class, which provides media pipeline capabilities such as supported MIME types and MIME type support checks, within an IPC (Inter-Process Communication) framework for the Rialto media server.

classes.name: MediaPipelineCapabilitiesModuleService
classes.description: Implements the IPC service for media pipeline capabilities, handling client connections, disconnections, and requests for supported MIME types and MIME type support status.

methods.name: clientConnected
methods.description: Handles a new client connection, exporting the service to the client.

methods.name: getSupportedMimeTypes
methods.description: Responds to requests for supported MIME types based on media source type.

methods.name: isMimeTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific MIME type is supported.
